title: Ionic Formula, Naming, and Compound Study Tool
author: Dr. Dan
description: Interactive chemistry study tool for practicing chemical formulas and nomenclature. Includes Study/Quiz Mode with Mixed Practice, Binary Ionic Only, Polyatomic Ionic Only, Formula to Name, Name to Formula/Build, Acids Only, and Covalent Only practice. Covers Type I and Type II ionic compounds, polyatomic ions, oxyanion naming patterns, binary acids, oxyacids, and binary covalent compounds using prefixes mono- through deca-. Also includes a Free Builder Mode, formula math editor with subscripts, hints, answer reveal, score and streak tracking, and periodic table references.
